Eight clubs · One conference

Team Directory

From Beacon to Rhinebeck and Catskill to Kingston, the HVHC's eight clubs cover the Hudson Valley from the Catskills foothills to the river. Every team competes in the U18 AA tier under USA Hockey sanction.

HVHC U18 AA Junior Hockey · Est. 1998

Hudson Valley Hockey Conference is a non-profit U18 AA junior hockey league sanctioned by USA Hockey and serving the Hudson Valley region of New York since 1998.
